countries.reasoning: Based on industry reports from 2022-2023 showing the US as the largest FBS producer, with extensive biotech and pharma manufacturing facilities. Data is reasonably current and reliable although exact production volumes are often proprietary.
UK hosts major biotech firms producing FBS, with data from 2021-2023 biotech industry sources. Moderate confidence due to niche market and some proprietary restrictions on volumes.
Germany has significant animal serum producers with production reported in industry market research from 2022, but total volumes are less publicly disclosed.
Brazilian serum production is known but data is sparse and production estimates are based on regional animal biotechnology industry reports around 2021-2022.
China is an emerging producer of FBS with some industry-level production increasing in recent years, but exact data on amounts is limited and less transparent.
